comment:
* A helper class that aims to provide comparable growth performance to ArrayList, but on primitive
 * arrays. Common array operations are implemented for efficient use in dynamic containers.
 *
 * All methods in this class assume that the length of an array is equivalent to its capacity and
 * NOT the number of elements in the array. The current size of the array is always passed in as a
 * parameter.
 *
 * @hide

methods.name: public static T[] append(T[] array, int currentSize, T element)
methods.comment:
* Appends an element to the end of the array, growing the array if there is no more room.
     * @param array The array to which to append the element. This must NOT be null.
     * @param currentSize The number of elements in the array. Must be less than or equal to
     *                    array.length.
     * @param element The element to append.
     * @return the array to which the element was appended. This may be different than the given
     *         array.

methods.name: public static int[] append(int[] array, int currentSize, int element)
methods.comment: * Primitive int version of {@link #append(Object[], int, Object)}.

methods.name: public static long[] append(long[] array, int currentSize, long element)
methods.comment: * Primitive long version of {@link #append(Object[], int, Object)}.

methods.name: public static boolean[] append(boolean[] array, int currentSize, boolean element)
methods.comment: * Primitive boolean version of {@link #append(Object[], int, Object)}.

methods.name: public static float[] append(float[] array, int currentSize, float element)
methods.comment: * Primitive float version of {@link #append(Object[], int, Object)}.

methods.name: public static T[] insert(T[] array, int currentSize, int index, T element)
methods.comment:
* Inserts an element into the array at the specified index, growing the array if there is no
     * more room.
     *
     * @param array The array to which to append the element. Must NOT be null.
     * @param currentSize The number of elements in the array. Must be less than or equal to
     *                    array.length.
     * @param element The element to insert.
     * @return the array to which the element was appended. This may be different than the given
     *         array.

methods.name: public static int[] insert(int[] array, int currentSize, int index, int element)
methods.comment: * Primitive int version of {@link #insert(Object[], int, int, Object)}.

methods.name: public static long[] insert(long[] array, int currentSize, int index, long element)
methods.comment: * Primitive long version of {@link #insert(Object[], int, int, Object)}.

methods.name: public static boolean[] insert(boolean[] array, int currentSize, int index, boolean element)
methods.comment: * Primitive boolean version of {@link #insert(Object[], int, int, Object)}.

methods.name: public static int growSize(int currentSize)
methods.comment:
* Given the current size of an array, returns an ideal size to which the array should grow.
     * This is typically double the given size, but should not be relied upon to do so in the
     * future.
